Definition: desire (and so probably in Proverbs 31:4); hence (by way of alternative) or, also if
BiblicalUsage: Or is the word of the alternative, and the Bible is full of its choices. Solomon prayed that if the people sinned against the Lord, whether in one thing or another, and the priests struck the offering into the pan, or kettle, or caldron, or pot.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the little word or is the sign of God's either-or: blessing or curse, obedience or rebellion, and the choice is always mine to make.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
